abIntro.berichtshefte_ihrer_azubis_pruefen_und: Review and sign off your apprentices' report books
abIntro.diese_seite_hat_zwei_betriebsarten: This page works in two modes. With an account it is the overview of every apprentice in your company and all of their weeks. Without an account it shows a single week — the one your apprentice sent you a link for.
abIntro.mit_konto_alle_azubis_an: With an account: every apprentice in one place
abIntro.ihre_azubis_verbinden_ihr_berichtsheft: Your apprentices connect their report book to your company once, using an invite code. After that every finished week turns up here by itself. Nothing to collect, nothing to print, no links to keep track of.
abIntro.offene_wochen_zuerst_mit_zeitraum: Open weeks first, with the date range, the days and the activities exactly as in the record.
abIntro.bestaetigen_mit_einem_klick_zurueckgeben: Approve with one click, send back with a comment. Your decision then appears in the apprentice's report book.
abIntro.ausbildungsnachweise_sind_nach_14_bbig: Under §14 BBiG training records must be reviewed at least monthly. The overview points out which week has been waiting too long.
abIntro.jede_entscheidung_bleibt_mit_name: Every decision stays in the audit trail with the name and the time, signed on your own device.
abIntro.mehrere_ausbilder_je_betrieb_auch: Several trainers per company, including holiday cover through a time-limited code.
abIntro.aendert_ein_azubi_eine_woche: If an apprentice changes a week after it was approved, the overview lists it as open again.
abIntro.anmelden_und_uebersicht_oeffnen: Sign in and open the overview
abIntro.noch_kein_betrieb_hinterlegt_nach: No company set up yet? Once you have signed in, you create it here and generate the first invite code. The account route is new — the link route below stays exactly as it was.
abIntro.ohne_konto_eine_einzelne_woche: Without an account: a single week via a link
abIntro.fuer_betriebe_die_kein_konto: For companies that would rather not create an account. All you need is your apprentice's link or QR code.
abIntro.ihr_azubi_zeigt_ihnen_einen: Your apprentice shows you a QR code or sends you a link.
abIntro.sie_lesen_die_woche_hier: You read the week here and tap Approve or Send back.
abIntro.sie_erhalten_einen_kurzen_antwortcode: You get a short response code that your apprentice scans with their phone camera. Your decision then appears in their training record.
abIntro.bei_diesem_weg_steckt_die: On this route the week is contained in the link itself. It is not transmitted to a server and is not stored anywhere — the part of an address after the hash mark never leaves the device.

abErrText.bitte_lassen_sie_sich_den: Please ask for the link again. It may have been cut short when it was copied.

__title: Trainers: review and sign off report books | MyWorkLog
__metaDescription: Review, sign off or send back every weekly report of your apprentices in one place — as a company overview with an account, or per week via a link without one.
__ogTitle: Trainers: review and sign off report books
__ogDescription: Every week of every apprentice in one place: approve, send back, keep the monthly deadline in view. Without an account, a single week still works via a link.

mainEntity.name: Does a trainer need their own account for MyWorkLog?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the overview of all apprentices, yes: the training company is created with an account and apprentices join with an invite code. For a single week, no — if the apprentice sends an approval link, that week can be viewed and signed off without an account and without signing in.

mainEntity.name: How do the weekly reports reach the trainer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through the company: the trainer creates an invite code and the apprentice enters it in their report book. From then on every finished week appears in the trainer overview, with nobody having to send anything. Alternatively the apprentice sends one link per week or shows a QR code.

mainEntity.name: Does a trainer see all apprentices at a glance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The overview shows each apprentice's training year, their most recent submission and all of their weeks, plus the numbers: how many weeks are waiting for approval, how many have been signed off, and which oldest week has been waiting too long.

mainEntity.name: Are the report books uploaded to a server?

acceptedAnswer.text: On the account route, yes: submitted weeks live in the training company's area, and access rules in the database make sure a company only ever sees its own apprentices. On the link route, no: there the week is contained in the link itself, after the hash mark — and that part of an address is never sent to the server.

mainEntity.name: Does the overview satisfy the review duty under §14 BBiG?

acceptedAnswer.text: It supports it. Training records must be reviewed at least once a month; the overview flags the oldest unreviewed week as soon as it is more than a month old. Every decision stays in the audit trail with the name and the time.

mainEntity.name: Can two trainers look after the same company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A trainer creates a time-limited deputy code for that. Whoever redeems it sees the same weeks and can make the same decisions. Every decision stays under the name of the person who made it, holiday cover included.

mainEntity.name: What happens if an apprentice changes a week that was already signed off?

acceptedAnswer.text: The week is listed as open again and marked as changed after approval. The old signature does not travel into the PDF, and the trainer decides again.

mainEntity.name: Does the trainer overview cost anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. MyWorkLog is free and ad-free, and that includes access for training companies. There is no per-apprentice licence and no contract.
